responsibilities: Develop a deep understanding of SME business processes, products, distribution models, performance drivers, and information needs and apply that knowledge to BI solution design.
Partner with business stakeholders and BI leaders to translate business questions and analytical needs into scalable solutions and prioritized deliverables.
Design, develop, test, deploy, and support Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, and reusable analytical data products that provide a trusted view of SME business performance.
Build and maintain reporting across the SME insurance lifecycle, including submissions, indications, quotes, binds, policies, premium, portfolio performance, distribution, and operational activity.
Use advanced SQL to investigate, transform, validate, reconcile, and optimize complex datasets across multiple source systems and analytical platforms.
Develop dimensional and semantic models that support consistent business definitions, reusable measures, governed datasets, and self-service analytics.
Partner with Data Engineering and Technology teams to define data requirements, improve data quality, resolve defects, and deliver scalable and reliable data pipelines and analytical solutions.
Monitor and improve the usability, reliability, performance, and adoption of BI solutions while reducing fragmented or manually assembled reporting.
Contribute to the Global BI Center of Excellence through reusable patterns, standards, templates, documentation, and technical best practices.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Use advanced SQL to investigate, transform, validate, reconcile, and optimize complex datasets
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour: validation, reconciliation, governed datasets and data quality far outnumber the 'fast-paced environment' and 'speed and agility' phrases.
evidence.domain_risk: Build and maintain reporting across the SME insurance lifecycle, including submissions, indications, quotes, binds, policies, premium, portfolio performance
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Moderate: insurance is a default-high sector, but the duties are business performance reporting with no financial reporting, regulatory or audit language.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Contribute to the Global BI Center of Excellence through reusable patterns, standards, templates, documentation, and technical best practices.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Mature: a 'Global Business Intelligence organization' with a Center of Excellence, consistent BI engineering standards and a separate Data Engineering team.
evidence.jd_authorship: including submissions, indications, quotes, binds, policies, premium, portfolio performance, distribution, and operational activity
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Hiring manager: bullets name the insurance lifecycle stages and the Power BI semantic model work concretely.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: This role will support BHSI’s Small and Medium Enterprise (SME) business, including our digital and direct-to-broker distribution capabilities
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Commercial: the audience is the SME business unit and its distribution and broker performance.
evidence.autonomy_level: Develop and execute a BI roadmap driven by business value and strategic priorities
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Mixed: the role owns a BI roadmap and models while delivering reporting in support of the SME business.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI skill is expected of the candidate.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Responsibility: the role tests its own Power BI deliverables and improves data quality with Data Engineering, though no testing tool is named.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Establish a consistent, trusted view of performance across the SME business
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: High: trust appears in the role summary ('trusted data models') and recurs with governed datasets and reconciliation throughout.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: reducing fragmented or manually assembled reporting
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Fix and scale: the role evolves reporting and replaces fragmented manual reports within an existing BI function.
evidence.loss_aversion: Establish a consistent, trusted view of performance across the SME business — trust and governance are the success measures.
